connector.name: DocVerdict
connector.registryDescription: PDF, photo, email, and file comparison evidence checks with plain-language reports.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.docverdict.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rogerberent-netizen account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key. Self-serve at https://docverdict.com/api-access. Optional: a keyless trial allows 3 calls per day per IP.
